root_cause: manifest_version is a durable task mutation/CAS lineage counter and is incremented by every legal resume takeover. The latest_meta_maintenance_run_ref is the latest completed formal maintenance proof and may legitimately predate a task-only mutation. Requiring target_manifest_version == current manifest_version conflates these two lifecycles and forces either fake formal runs or CI failure after ordinary takeover. The V53 workaround generated a new formal run on takeover, but the newer during-execution controller correctly forbids treating an incomplete trajectory as a completed formal proof, exposing the architectural mismatch again.

history_search.prior_fix: Generate a current-manifest-version formal meta closure and synchronize status cache after takeover.
history_search.why_prior_fix_is_now_insufficient: Formal maintenance proof must represent a genuinely completed maintenance trajectory. A lease-only task mutation is not itself a new formal maintenance proof, and an in-progress controller run cannot be backfilled as completed merely to satisfy version equality.

alternatives.reason: Contradicts the authoritative single-writer/CAS takeover contract and weakens stale-writer detection.
Repeats the V53 mechanism, inflates proof artifacts, and can falsely imply a completed maintenance trajectory.

Preserves both truthful task mutation lineage and truthful formal proof chronology. The latest completed run must be internally valid and target a manifest version not newer than the current task manifest; equality is not required for task-only mutations.

accepted_invariant.manifest_version: task authority mutation/CAS lineage; increments on legal takeover and other durable task-state writes
accepted_invariant.latest_meta_maintenance_run_ref: latest completed formal meta-maintenance proof, not a mirror of every task mutation
accepted_invariant.target_manifest_version_rule: latest completed formal run target_manifest_version MUST be <= current manifest_version; exact equality may be required only by a separate explicit promotion/freshness gate, not by generic task versioning
accepted_invariant.in_progress_rule: an ACTIVE/BLOCKED controller trajectory must never be fabricated into a completed formal meta-run just to satisfy version equality

implementation_plan: change the stale-or-missing meta-run regression from exact target/current manifest equality to non-future binding plus full run structural evaluation
record the binding model explicitly in the maintenance task manifest/handoff
retain the latest completed formal run pointer until a genuine completed formal promotion replaces it
add/retain CI regression coverage so a future takeover can advance manifest_version without requiring fabricated meta evidence

complexity.test_change: one incorrect equality invariant is replaced by the correct lifecycle relation

assurance_boundary: This decoupling prevents false CI failures and fake proof generation. It does not by itself prove that the latest formal meta-run covers every later semantic change; semantic promotion remains an explicit maintenance/closure responsibility and is represented separately from the task mutation counter.
